name: Recall
summary: Video transcript RAG search & chat, with second-exact YouTube deep links.

manualSteps.title: Connect Replicate
manualSteps.body: Add your Replicate API token under Settings → AI → AI Services. Powers transcription (WhisperX), transcript-chunk indexing, and query embeddings for both search and chat.

manualSteps.title: Connect Anthropic
manualSteps.body: Add an Anthropic API key under Settings → AI → AI Services. It powers the public chat (Claude Haiku 4.5, streaming).

manualSteps.title: Enable the AI Data Tools plugin
manualSteps.body: Turn on AI Data Tools under Settings → AI → AI Plugins. Without it, chat's search_videos tool is invisible to the model and it prints raw tool-call XML instead of citing a video.

manualSteps.title: Let the browser upload to your bucket
manualSteps.body: Uploads go straight from the browser to your storage bucket, so the bucket needs a CORS rule allowing PUT and GET from {appHost}. CE can't set this for you — do it in your cloud console.
